AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
This app manages personal notes and can display them on the user's connected display glasses.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'createNote' to create a new note with a topic and body text, optionally displaying it on connected glasses. - Use 'showLatestNotes' to display the N most recent notes on the glasses. - Use 'searchNotesOnGlasses' to display notes whose title or text contains a given query.
Constraints: - 'createNote' requires non-blank topic and text parameters. - 'showLatestNotes' and 'searchNotesOnGlasses' require at least one existing note; otherwise no notes are shown.
